name: Web design and development
description: We design and build websites from the first conversation to the day you take over, and we can keep looking after them after launch.
bestFor: Businesses that need a new website or a full rebuild, and want one team to design it, build it and look after it.
howItStarts: With a call, or a meeting in person if you prefer, so we get to know each other and the business before anything is drawn.

phases.title: Brief
phases.description: Understanding what you want: the goals, the audience and what the site needs to do.

phases.title: Moodboard
phases.description: We gather references and find out what you like, and what you don’t.

phases.title: UX
phases.description: The page breakdown: what you want to show on each page. The skeleton of the website.

phases.title: UI
phases.description: The skeleton gets its skin. Every page is designed and ready for your sign-off.

phases.title: Development
phases.description: We build the site and test it on phones and desktops before it goes live.

phases.title: Handover
phases.description: A recorded call showing you how to manage the site, or we take care of hosting and care.
